# VIVUM Digital Agency | وكالة فيفوم الرقمية

> VIVUM is a premier regional digital agency providing creative design, modern web & mobile software engineering, custom AI solutions, and UI/UX design across the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh), and Syria (Damascus).

## Key Agency Information
- **Official Name:** VIVUM Digital Agency (وكالة فيفوم الرقمية)
- **Website:** https://vivum-d2907.web.app/
- **Target Regions:** UAE (United Arab Emirates / دبي), KSA (Saudi Arabia / الرياض), Syria (دمشق).
- **Languages Supported:** Arabic (العربية), English (En).

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Web & Mobile Application Engineering:**
   - Single Page Applications (SPA), Progressive Web Apps (PWA), and Flutter Web apps.
   - Cross-platform Android & iOS applications with native performance.
   - High-throughput backend integrations (Firebase Firestore, Supabase, Cloud Functions).
2. **AI Solutions & Automation:**
   - Autonomous AI Agents, Custom Chatbots, and LLM integrations.
   - Automated workflow systems and client management integrations.
3. **UI/UX & Brand Identity:**
   - Modern Material 3 dark/light responsive design systems.
   - High-converting landing pages, interactive micro-animations, dynamic regional localization.
4. **Digital Transformation & Consulting:**
   - Regional software deployment, performance optimization, cloud security, and Firestore/Supabase infrastructure.

## Available Routes & Navigation
- `/` - **Home Page:** Hero showcase, regional presence (UAE, KSA, Syria), core services summary, client statistics, and agency highlights.
- `/about` - **About Us:** Agency mission, values, creative story, leadership vision, and company background.
- `/services` - **Services Page:** In-depth breakdown of Web Development, AI Automation, Mobile Apps, UI/UX Design, and Software Consulting.
- `/portfolio` - **Portfolio Page:** Interactive showcase of completed digital projects, web platforms, and mobile apps categorized by Web, Branding, and AI.
- `/process` - **Process Page:** Step-by-step methodology from initial discovery and prototyping to engineering, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
- `/contact` - **Contact Us:** Interactive client inquiry form, direct communication channels, and consultation scheduling.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework:** Flutter Web (Dart SDK 3.x), optimized with `usePathUrlStrategy()` for clean deep-link routing.
- **State & DI:** Custom `AppProvider` (InheritedWidget) supporting real-time theme toggling (Dark/Light) and language switching (RTL Arabic / LTR English).
- **Backend Infrastructure:** Firebase Core, Cloud Firestore, Firebase App Check, Supabase Storage, and Google Analytics.
- **Full Specification:** https://vivum-d2907.web.app/llms-full.txt
- **AI Catalog JSON:** https://vivum-d2907.web.app/ai-catalog.json
